note: Frames name the chart, never a trait. Slots: {stars} (chính tinh ở Mệnh, nối bằng 'và'), {branch}, {star} (one star), {opp_stars} (chính tinh cung đối diện, for vô chính diệu), {dignity} (a phrase from 'dignity'). Drafted by Claude 2026-10-18, review pending. anchor_palace: the same frames for any palace other than Mệnh ({palace}). via: a concept of the chapter's kind read only at another palace ({from}, {S}). vcd = the reading rests on the opposite palace's stars; vcd_own = it rests on stars standing in the empty palace ({own}); vcd_plain = neither (chart-level facts). anchor_palace frames end in {S}: the person (subject.palace_first) or, in Phu Thê and Nô Bộc, the other people the reading is about (other[palace]) when the concept is not about the bond itself.
